_schema: off-market-deal-finder class scoring v2.0. See references/pipeline-contract.md Section 11 for the band schema and references/scoring/shared_adjustments.json for multipliers, tiers, caps and suppressions. Weights sum to 100.

factors.name: regulatory_event_timing

bands.reading: Year 30 cliff: restrictions end, conversion or preservation sale is being negotiated now; Oregon PuSH notices are due in this window.
bands.lever: Preservation purchaser or conversion buyer; position before the first notice.

bands.reading: Cliff visible; owner choosing between resyndication and exit.
Syndicator LP exiting; for-profit GP negotiating buyout, resyndication or third-party sale.
bands.lever: GP letter plus LP courtesy call; fund the LP exit.

bands.reading: Nonprofit GP will exercise the §42(i)(7) ROFR at minimum price; the asset is not for sale to a third party.
bands.lever: Route partnership_preservation: recap or JV partner.

bands.reading: Stalled Year-15 exit; LP interests may have traded to an aggregator.
bands.lever: Ask who holds the LP interest.

bands.reading: Renewal decision point; owner weighs MAHRA renewal, Mark-Up-to-Market or opt-out with 1-year tenant notice.
236 / 221(d)(3) / 202 maturity ends the use agreement unless decoupled or refinanced.
bands.lever: RAD / Section 8 preservation tools; recapitalization partner.

bands.reading: 515 maturity ends interest credit and RA; owner exits or transfers with RD financing.
USDA projects program exit within 3 years.
bands.lever: As above; confirm with RD state office.

bands.reading: 515 maturity on the horizon.
HOME/OAHTC/state affordability period ending; rent limits lift on those units, OAHTC pass-through rate ends.
bands.lever: Corroborating; stack with other programs (see regulatory_stacking).

bands.reading: Last known restriction ends within 3 years.
bands.lever: Confirm which agreement is last; request LURA.

modifiers.reading: Repeated 1-5 year renewals by a for-profit owner: keeping options open.
Just signed a 20-year renewal; staying in the program.
IRP expires with the loan; decoupling or prepayment decision.

modifiers.lever: Conversion risk is real; preservation buyer has leverage with HUD.

modifiers.reading: Owner may prepay now with 180-day notice and tenant protections.

factors.notes: Take max of bands, add modifiers, cap 25, then basis multiplier. HAP_EXPIRATION carries confidence 0.70 when annually renewing (apply as an additional multiplier on this band only). LIFT / 60-year REUA with extended use > 30 years out scores 0 here (shared_adjustments.caps.lift_60yr).

factors.name: declared_intent_and_notice

bands.reading: Owner has formally told OHCS and the city the restrictions will end; qualified purchasers now hold statutory rights.
bands.lever: Strongest affordable signal; position as or with a qualified purchaser.

bands.reading: Section 8 opt-out notice on file with the PBCA / HUD; tenants get enhanced vouchers.
bands.lever: Preservation purchase that keeps the HAP.

bands.reading: Agency failed to present a qualified contract; 3-year decontrol is running.
Owner has asked the agency for a qualified contract; one-year clock.
bands.lever: You can be the qualified-contract buyer.

bands.reading: A qualified purchaser has recorded its right to match any third-party offer within 30 days.
bands.lever: rofr_encumbered: designee / JV strategy, not a direct offer.

bands.reading: Pre-waiver vintage past year 14 with no waiver in the REUA; the owner holds a conversion lever.
bands.lever: Ask whether a QC request is contemplated.

bands.reading: On the OHCS 10-year forecast but no notice yet.

modifiers.reading: The Oregon PuSH first-notice window (36-30 months before the last restriction ends; OAR 813-115 snippets, statute text unverified) is open as of the run date: if the owner intends to exit, the notice is due now.
modifiers.lever: File a records request with the PuSH-CP Program Manager and the affected city for any notice received; a confirmed notice upgrades this to PRESERVATION_NOTICE_RECEIVED (20).

factors.notes: push_window_open is additive (cap 20) so a property inside its statutory notice window ranks above an otherwise identical one outside it; it is derived from PRESERVATION_NOTICE_WINDOW window_start <= as_of <= window_end and emitted only for 5+ unit properties with a PuSH-covered program.

factors.name: capital_stack_pressure

bands.reading: HUD / USDA / agency / CMBS / recorded first mortgage matures within 3 years.
bands.lever: Recap or sale; assumable HUD debt is a buyer edge.

bands.reading: Maturity inside the 5-year horizon.
Debt leg of the 236/202 maturity (regulatory leg scored above).
Debt leg of the 515 maturity.

modifiers.reading: Restricted NOI cannot carry the balance at today's rates.
modifiers.lever: Soft-debt resubordination or new equity is required; be the equity.

modifiers.reading: Recorded soft loan balloons with the first mortgage: stacked balloon.
modifiers.lever: Soft lender consent is part of the deal.

factors.notes: A PROXY LOAN_MATURITY (Financial_Closing_Date + 15y mini-perm) scores through the same bands; the 0.30 basis multiplier is the only penalty. No extra rule.

factors.name: regulatory_stacking

bands.reading: Two regulatory agreements end within the same 24 months.
Three or more agreements end together: stacked balloon of restrictions.
bands.lever: The owner must transact; be first.

modifiers.reading: HAP and extended-use cliffs coincide: the classic preservation-sale trigger.

factors.notes: Counts REGULATORY-family events (SOFT_PROGRAM_END per program, HAP_EXPIRATION, LIHTC_EXTENDED_USE_END, HUD/USDA regulatory legs) whose dates fall within a rolling 24-month window. Cap 10.

factors.name: owner_sponsor_profile

bands.reading: For-profit or Limited Dividend GP: sells at Year 15/30 when the math works.
Mission owner; exercises ROFR or recapitalizes.
bands.lever: partnership_preservation route; +5 motivation on that track only.

bands.reading: Rarely sells; RAD or conversion partner at most.

modifiers.reading: LP interest traded to an aggregator or GP changed; contested or accelerated exit.
modifiers.lever: Find out who now controls the LP vote.

modifiers.reading: Sponsor faces several Year 15/30 events at once; capacity constrained.
Out-of-state sponsor less tied to Oregon preservation politics.
Mark-to-Market restructure with HUD-held notes: complex but motivated.
modifiers.lever: Note assignment/forgiveness in a preservation sale.

factors.notes: Cap 15, floor 0 after the housing-authority penalty (the route change carries the real effect).

factors.name: operating_distress

bands.reading: Automatic referral to the Departmental Enforcement Center.
Regulated apartment on the ORS 312 list: severe.
Failed inspection; capital-needs backlog, owner fatigue.
Taxes unpaid on a regulated asset: operating distress.
Nonprofit low-income exemption dropped: ownership change or compliance failure.
OHCS already classified the asset as at risk.
Steep decline even if passing.
Occupancy under 85% or down 10 points.

factors.notes: NSPIRE (from 7/1/2023) and legacy UPCS scores are not directly comparable; use detail=protocol when trending. LIHTC-only properties are inspected by the HFA and those scores are not public.

bands.reading: Two independent families.
Regulatory, debt and operating signals converge.
bands.lever: Top priority on the relevant track.

routes.condition: owner_type in [lihtc_partnership_nonprofit_gp, nonprofit] AND (ROFR_RECORDED OR PRAC)

quality_rules: LIFT or 60-year REUA with extended-use end > 30 years out -> urgency SCHEDULED, no timing points.
Proxy-only governing events -> tier cap C (proxy-only label).
SOFT_PROGRAM_END is an affordability-period end, not a note maturity; a soft-loan balloon scores only when recorded (SOFT_LOAN_MATURITY).
HAP expiration dates under annual renewal roll forward each year; 'expiring in 12 months' is not 'leaving the program' until a notice is confirmed.
